method: Executed with integrated Chromium and Playwright tools on local HTTP root and nested-folder deployments.

checks.observed: The introduction explains terrain, observation duration and protected reserve, with HOMEBOUND Interactive Marswalk Planner as the product heading.
P is initially selected and explicitly hypothetical. It uses row 70, column 37; original H/A/B/C and nominal assumptions are unchanged.
Review and Save remain unavailable before a calculation. The four steps have labeled navigation and focused headings.
The nominal 20-minute practice observation gives 61.92 min extra margin; actual directional times are about 8.77 and 9.31 min.
Adding 63 min changes observation from 20 to 83 min and margin to -1.0830014565751185 min. Original plan remains intact.
Additional observation calculation reports cached route search reused.
Restore original resets extra duration to zero and recovers the original 61.92 min margin.
Editing extra duration sets STALE and disables saving until recalculation or explicit restoration.
Editing a primary value clears old brief content and exports, disables Save, and shows a warning rather than printing an old plan.
With a 1.5-second grid delay, editing observation to 21 min before the reply preserves the edited step and rejects the obsolete result; recalculation gives 60.92 min margin.
A remains NO_MODELED_ROUTE at 20 degrees, with null time/route. Its finding can be saved without relocating the origin.
No-route comparison controls are hidden and a clear reason is shown; the Save finding path remains available.
One in-memory response cell is marked unknown. UI returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null route/time and an exportable unavailable finding; source files are not changed.
An invalid negative mission budget produces visible validation/error feedback rather than a feasible plan.
Data & assumptions opens and lists the three primary product references with qualitative thermal limitations.
Optical, opportunity, elevation, slope and qualitative thermal selections produce five distinct canvas images; whole-area and focused views differ.
Keyboard-entered row 70, column 37 produces a labeled custom hypothetical result and preserves origin row 105, column 43.
Clicking the map normally does not change the destination. Explicit picking sets aria-pressed and selects valid integer grid coordinates (observed row 87, column 39).
Manually setting A's slope limit to 25 degrees rebuilds routing and yields about 37.45 min margin; this is not an automatic limit change or a safety recommendation.
Actual CSS viewport 390 x 844; document width 375, with the narrow layout active and no horizontal overflow.
Native Tab navigation and Enter activate the guided plan, destination continuation and review. This is not a full WCAG conformance audit.
Actual generated Blob text/JSON retain version, hypothetical purpose, original/revised plan, 20-minute reserve, source hashes and claim boundary. Temporary test instrumentation was removed.
Current brief is printable with application header hidden; after invalidation the old brief is empty and the print warning is visible. Native OS/PDF dialogs are not claimed as tested.
The application, worker and relative data paths operate at / and /nested/homebound/. Desktop checks used an actual 977 x 848 CSS viewport after a 980 x 850 request.
Keyboard activation enters the ready planner and focuses the Step 1 heading rather than targeting a hidden section.
A deliberate one-time application.json HTTP 503 produces visible feedback with Start disabled. Retry loads the approved scenario successfully without substituting data.

limitations: No human usability pilot, astronaut/analog study, expert science validation, physical route validation or complete accessibility audit has been performed.
Native file-save and PDF dialogs and the actual Rumahweb account require post-upload checks. Generated payloads and print CSS were checked without claiming those dialogs.
Missing-data, delayed-grid and initial HTTP 503 tests use explicitly labeled development-only server fixtures; original prepared source files remain unchanged.

Integrated-browser network interception was unreliable; reproducible preview-server fixtures were used instead. An oversized requested viewport also caused tool pointer-coordinate mismatch; DOM hit testing showed no application overlap, and normal desktop pointer tests were rerun successfully within the actual viewport.
All test servers were temporary local helpers, not production deployments.
